name: dynamic-island-morph
title: Dynamic Island Morph
description: A compact floating pill header that morphs smoothly into a wide notification panel upon incoming state event.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Expandable Island Capsule: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
